name: Yokubou ~Shokushu no Amai Wana~
source:
Dark sexual-violation tentacle novel produced by Shirase Ryuichi, featuring 5 voice actresses. One day, unknown eggs showered down on the premises of the school. Several years past, monsters were hatched from the eggs and begun to nail girls in the school ...

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE016478.html]DLsite English[/url]]

一部由白濑龙一制作、共5名声优参演的黑暗触手凌辱小说。某天，来历不明的卵如雨点般落入校园。数年后，怪物从卵中孵化，开始对校内女生展开凌辱……
